parameter_status: Document-based 25T and file-based vertical input; assumed support/speed; 7-DOF reduction; lateral channels not applied

assumptions.speed: 120 km/h scenario assumption; no operating speed specified in source document
assumptions.support: Legacy linear bilateral equivalent axle support, not Hertz contact; source does not give these values
assumptions.track: Imported source in metres; C1 PCHIP interpolation; 5 m synthetic lead-in before first sample; no extrapolation beyond last sample
assumptions.dampers: Two per axle / two per bogie; odd symmetry, origin added, linear interpolation and last-segment extrapolation
assumptions.damper_joints: Source joint stiffnesses recorded but not modeled; dampers act directly on relative vertical velocity
assumptions.reduction: Seven vertical translations only; axlebox mass lumped, no pitch/roll/yaw or arm inertia
assumptions.air_spring: Normal inflated linear equivalent; deflated case not modeled
assumptions.track_reduction: Use (Lv+Rv)/2 for symmetric vertical support; retain Ld/Rd for export only, no lateral/roll dynamics

reference_only_not_used.inertia_note: Source says carbody parameter origin is at car center on rail plane. Do not assign directly as COM inertias without clarifying reference axes.

track_source.units: All five columns in metres; already converted by measurement2simpack.py
